foot and mouth.what_to_do: Isolate affected animals immediately. Contact your nearest vet or DVS office. Do not move animals off the farm. Report to authorities — FMD is a notifiable disease.
foot and mouth.symptoms: Blisters on hooves, mouth, and tongue. Excessive salivation, lameness, reduced milk production.
foot and mouth.prevention: Vaccination, restrict animal movement, biosecurity measures.

goat pox.what_to_do: Isolate affected animals. Contact a vet for antiviral treatment. Vaccinate healthy animals in the herd.
goat pox.symptoms: Raised skin nodules, fever, nasal discharge, difficulty breathing.
goat pox.prevention: Annual vaccination, quarantine new animals, avoid contact with infected herds.

healthy cattle.what_to_do: Your animal appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring, vaccination schedules, and good nutrition.
healthy cattle.prevention: Maintain regular vet checkups, vaccination, and clean water and feed.

healthy goat.what_to_do: Your goat appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and good husbandry practices.
healthy goat.prevention: Maintain regular vet checkups, vaccination, and clean water and feed.

lumpy cow disease.what_to_do: Isolate affected animals. Contact a vet for supportive treatment. Vaccinate the rest of the herd. Control insects around the farm.
lumpy cow disease.symptoms: Raised skin nodules across the body, fever, nasal discharge, reduced milk production, swollen lymph nodes.
lumpy cow disease.prevention: Annual vaccination, insect control, quarantine new animals.

watermelon mosaic virus.what_to_do: Remove and destroy infected plants. Control aphid populations with insecticide. Do not plant cucurbits near infected areas.
watermelon mosaic virus.symptoms: Mottled yellow-green mosaic on leaves, distorted fruit, stunted growth.
watermelon mosaic virus.prevention: Use virus-resistant varieties, control aphids, remove weeds around the field.

healthy watermelon.what_to_do: Your plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring, irrigation, and fertilisation.
healthy watermelon.prevention: Maintain crop rotation, control pests, ensure proper irrigation.

sorghum cereal grain mold.what_to_do: Harvest early before full maturity in wet seasons. Dry grain quickly after harvest. Use fungicide if caught early.
sorghum cereal grain mold.symptoms: Pink, red, or black discolouration on grain heads, shrivelled grain.
sorghum cereal grain mold.prevention: Use mould-resistant varieties, avoid delayed harvest, improve field drainage.

potato late blight.what_to_do: Apply fungicide immediately. Remove and destroy infected plant material. Avoid overhead irrigation.
potato late blight.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaves and stems, white mould on undersides of leaves, rotting tubers.
potato late blight.prevention: Use resistant varieties, apply preventive fungicide, avoid wet conditions.

tomato late blight.what_to_do: Apply fungicide immediately. Remove and destroy infected plant material. Avoid overhead irrigation.
tomato late blight.symptoms: Dark water-soaked lesions on leaves and fruit, white mould growth, rapid plant collapse.
tomato late blight.prevention: Use resistant varieties, apply preventive fungicide, improve air circulation.

healthy potato.what_to_do: Your plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and good crop management.
healthy potato.prevention: Maintain crop rotation, control pests, ensure proper irrigation.

healthy tomato.what_to_do: Your plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and good crop management.
healthy tomato.prevention: Maintain crop rotation, control pests, ensure proper irrigation.
